question: Where can I get a list of hydrogen production projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No single list gives stage and date for electrolysis projects in permitting. DOE Record 24001 (May 2024) lists 43 planned rows without developers or dates; stage, developer and MW come from dockets: Lancaster Clean Energy Center (CEQA approval 2024-03-11, 400 MWe) and Plug Power's Graham, Texas project (DOE FONSI 2025-01-10, twelve 10 MW; agreed for sale July 2026). DOE hub pages are hub-level and stale; the PNWH2 award was reported rescinded in October 2025.
main_caveats: DOE Record 24001 is dated May 2024: it lists Graham, TX as Planned/Under Construction although Plug Power agreed in July 2026 to sell that project; it has no developer or stage date.
A DOE FONSI (Graham, 2025-01-10) and a CEQA approval (Lancaster, 2024-03-11) are not financing, construction or operation: no building or start-of-construction document was found for either.
MW bases differ: 120 MW of electrolyzers, 45 tpd of hydrogen and 164 MW of grid interconnection describe Graham; Lancaster's '400 MWe' is undefined. None converts into another.
DOE hub pages predate the 2025 cuts (Canary Media: awards to two hubs rescinded) and show no electrolyzer-level project, MW or permit; DOE's EIS-0571 dates are anticipated only.
Only California and Texas dockets were opened; Washington, Oregon and other state portals and the IEA project file (account required) were not checked.
answer.confidence_reason: Two projects were traced from portal and DOE documents to dated stages and DOE's table counts reconcile, but no hub project was matched to a docket and most projects, states and the IEA file were not checked.

attributes.note: Lancaster CA (parcels, cross streets) and Graham TX (2264 FM 209) are documented to address level; DOE Table 1 gives city and state for planned rows; no list has coordinates.
attributes.gap_note: Only two projects were traced to site documents; hub projects and other states' dockets were not opened.

attributes.note: Lancaster 400 MWe of electrolyzers; Graham twelve 10 MW units (45 tpd, a separate measure); DOE gives kW for 43 planned rows. Hub documents give tons per day only.
attributes.gap_note: Basis of DOE's kW and of Lancaster's 'MWe' not defined; capacity for other projects was not checked.

attributes.note: Element New Energy Lancaster 1, LLC (Lancaster) and Plug Power (Graham) are named in dockets; DOE Table 1 omits developers and hub pages name consortia.
attributes.gap_note: Developers of the other 41 planned rows and of hub projects were not identified.

attributes.note: Lancaster: CEQA approval (MND) 2024-03-11. Graham: DOE FONSI 2025-01-10, work paused since Dec 2023, sale agreed July 2026. DOE's statuses are only Planned/Under Construction.
attributes.gap_note: No national stage field; hub projects have no site-specific review yet; construction status of Lancaster after March 2024 was not verified.

attributes.note: Dated events for two projects: Lancaster NOD 2024-03-12 (approved 03-11); Graham EA public comment from 2024-12-06, FONSI 2025-01-10, sale release 2026-07-13.
attributes.gap_note: No list gives stage dates; DOE Record 24001 has none; EIS-0571 dates are anticipated.

sources.name: CEQAnet: California CEQA records for hydrogen production projects (example SCH 2024020266, Lancaster Clean Energy Center)
sources.publisher: California Governor's Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation (LCI), State Clearinghouse
sources.format: HTML record pages, per-document CSV export and PDF attachments
sources.summary: City of Lancaster CEQA record: Lancaster Clean Energy Center (Element New Energy Lancaster 1, LLC), 400 MWe of electrolyzers with 650 MW PV; MND 2024-02-07, approved 2024-03-11.
sources.coverage_note: California only; one hydrogen project opened; approval stage, not construction.
caveats: Approval is not construction or operation.

problems: Free-text search is a Google Custom Search widget; a /Search 'q' parameter returned unrelated documents.

example.example_request: curl -sL https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2024020266/1 ; curl -sL https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2024020266/2 ; the attachment link on each record page is /2024020266/2/Attachment/<id>.
example.example_result: SCH 2024020266, Lead Agency City of Lancaster: document 1 MND received 2/7/2024 (state review 2/7-3/8/2024); document 2 NOD received 3/12/2024, approved 3/11/2024. Applicant Element New Energy Lancaster 1, LLC; 650 MW PV, 330 MWh storage, 400 MWe electrolyzers.

sources.name: DOE Office of NEPA Policy and Compliance pages for hydrogen production projects (DOE/EA-2281 Limestone; DOE/EIS-0571 Pacific Northwest Hydrogen Hub)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of NEPA Policy and Compliance
sources.format: HTML project pages and PDF environmental assessment (5.9 MB, 5,764 text lines)
sources.summary: DOE NEPA records: Limestone (Plug Power, Graham TX) EA with twelve 10 MW electrolyzers, 45 tpd, FONSI signed 2025-01-10; Pacific Northwest Hub EIS scope (about 10 projects) without sites or MW.
sources.coverage_note: Only DOE-financed projects; two pages opened; Limestone's later fate is outside DOE's page.
caveats: FONSI is not a loan or a building permit.
EIS schedule dates are anticipated, not confirmed.

members_summary.scope_note: Universe not counted: DOE NEPA pages for hydrogen production were found through search, not by listing. Two pages were opened; hub-related categorical exclusions (HyVelocity, Heartland) appeared in search results and were not opened.
members_summary.pattern: Search energy.gov/nepa for 'hydrogen' with the project or hub name; pages are titled DOE/EA-#### or DOE/EIS-####.

sources.name: DOE Hydrogen Program Record 24001, Electrolyzer Installations in the United States (planned and under-construction rows)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Hydrogen Program (HFTO)
sources.summary: 43 planned or under-construction electrolyzer rows (657 MW under construction, 3.75 GW planned) with city, kW and status; May 2024.
sources.coverage_note: No developer, no stage date; 18 months old; cancelled projects still listed.
caveats: Stale: Graham, TX has since been put up for sale.

sources.name: DOE Regional Clean Hydrogen Hubs selection pages (example: Pacific Northwest Hydrogen Hub, PNWH2)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations (OCED)
sources.summary: DOE hub selection pages give consortium, states and cost share only (PNWH2: up to $1 billion); the page predates the October 2025 rescission of two hubs' awards reported by Canary Media.
sources.coverage_note: Hub-level; no electrolyzer docket; one hub page opened; list page returns 404.
caveats: Page is stale relative to news of terminations.

problems: DOE's regional-hubs overview URLs (energy.gov/oced/regional-clean-hydrogen-hubs-0 and /cmei/oced/regional-clean-hydrogen-hubs) returned 404.

members_summary.scope_note: Seven hubs per Canary Media and CATF; only PNWH2 was opened. ARCHES (California) and PNWH2 awards were rescinded per Canary Media (2025-10-10); CATF (2026-05-11) says DOE's retain/modify list covers awards for five of the seven hubs.
members_summary.pattern: Open each hub's DOE page and its NEPA page, then search the hub's partners' permit dockets.

sources.name: Developer and city announcements on project status (Plug Power Graham sale release; City of Lancaster release)
sources.publisher: Plug Power Inc.; City of Lancaster, CA (via GlobeNewswire and PR Newswire reprints)
sources.summary: Plug Power agreed on 2026-07-13 to sell its Graham, Texas project (land and 164 MW of interconnection) to Stream; the City of Lancaster announced its commission's approval on 2024-03-20.
sources.coverage_note: Two projects; reprints of releases; closing of the Graham sale not confirmed.
caveats: Plug's release does not name Limestone or electrolyzers.
Sale closing only expected, not confirmed.

members_summary.scope_note: No universe: only the two projects traced in this card were checked.
members_summary.pattern: Search the developer's newsroom for the project's city and name.

if_unstructured.summary: Stage and dates are in project-specific documents: CEQA records for California projects, DOE NEPA documents for federally financed projects, and company or city releases for later status.

local_terms.term: CEQAnet / Notice of Determination (NOD) / Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND)
local_terms.meaning: California portal and documents; open each document of the SCH number for stage and date.

local_terms.term: DOE/EA-#### Final Environmental Assessment and FONSI
local_terms.meaning: DOE NEPA documents for financed projects; energy.gov/nepa pages carry the applicant, site and permits.
Seven DOE-selected hubs; hub pages are consortium-level.
DOE table of installed and planned electrolyzers; planned rows have no developer.
City or county use permit that appears as the CEQAnet title (for example CUP 23-019).

local_terms.term: Loan Programs Office (LPO) conditional commitment / loan guarantee
local_terms.meaning: DOE financing step referred to in the Graham EA; a FONSI is not the financing decision.
Texas air authorisation noted in the Graham EA (coverage began September 2023); no public docket was found.
DOE's 2026 list of awards it may keep; CATF reports it covers five of seven hubs.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
